section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews how aging relates to body appreciation and sexual health, noting inconsistent findings across multiple studies (some report negative, some positive associations; a large survey of 9,667 women reported a small positive correlation between age and body appreciation). It also summarizes that sexual functioning tends to decline with age while sexual distress and satisfaction often decrease or remain stable, and states the authors' aim to examine whether high body appreciation buffers the effects of age on sexual distress and satisfaction.
section_summary.evidence_source: In line with these researchers, we sought to examine whether high body appreciation,anindicatorofpositivebodyattitudesandabilityto relate to oneself adaptively despite potential and/or perceived flaws, serves as a buffer against the effects of age on sexual distress and satisfaction.
